description: Formal notices filed about the community entries of this app from OUTSIDE it, with no account — the route a rights holder or anyone who spots illegal content uses. Filing one suspends the entry immediately and opens a case here. Actions: "list" (optional status open|countered|upheld|dismissed) — open cases first, since those are the ones needing a human; "get" (caseId) — the full claim; "close" (caseId, outcome upheld|dismissed) — decides the CASE only. Closing does NOT put the entry back: restoring is a separate, deliberate act (neblla_moderate_community_entry with "restore"), so that dismissing a case by accident cannot republish something. A counter-notice from the author does not restore it either — that decision belongs to a human.
name: neblla_community_cases
